correctness.rationale: The up/down commutator on the n-2 residual coordinates yields orthogonal harmonic lifts with multiplicity d_t. Conditioning on a degree-t residual harmonic reduces the symmetric special-coordinate multiplicity space to a hypergeometric random variable R∈{0,1,2} with effective N_t=n-2t,K_t=k-t. The face indicator is the rank-one event R=2; compression to polynomials deg<=L-t gives 1 for deg>=2, the explicit A_t in deg=1, and B_t in deg=0. Swap-antisymmetric sectors vanish on R=2. Summing harmonic dimensions yields all eigenvalues, zero multiplicity, and rank, including degenerate B_(k-1)=0. Independently constructed polynomial evaluation projectors, not the supplied Johnson adjacency interpolation, matched exact eigenvalues and multiplicities for six (n,k,L) triples. Finite tests corroborate the general commutator proof.
